jobs.title: MES Integration Engineer (M/F/NB)
jobs.description:
W Etteplan wierzymy, że technologia ma sens tylko wtedy, gdy realnie wspiera ludzi i procesy biznesowe. Wspieramy naszych klientów w tworzeniu i rozwoju systemów IT oraz rozwiązań przemysłowych, które pomagają efektywniej zarządzać produkcją, danymi i procesami operacyjnymi.

Nasz dział Industrial Platform Solutions rozwija kompetencje związane z cyfryzacją przemysłu i systemami Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES). Tworzymy rozwiązania łączące świat IT z automatyką przemysłową, wspierając zakłady produkcyjne w obszarze integracji systemów, analizy danych procesowych i nowoczesnej produkcji cyfrowej.

Pracujemy blisko biznesu i rzeczywistych procesów produkcyjnych. Stawiamy na partnerską współpracę, prostotę rozwiązań i odpowiedzialność za dostarczane systemy.

O zespole i projektach

Dołączysz do zespołu rozwijającego i wdrażającego rozwiązania MES oparte o technologie AVEVA (Wonderware), m.in. Platformę Systemową, Model-Driven MES, Historian oraz rozwiązania integracyjne.

Realizujemy międzynarodowe projekty dla dużych firm produkcyjnych z branży spożywczej, chemicznej i przemysłowej. Obecnie prowadzimy rollouty systemów MES w zakładach na kilku kontynentach, rozwijając rozwiązania po zakończonym wdrożeniu pilotażowym.

Pracujemy projektowo – w zależności od etapu wdrożenia możesz uczestniczyć zarówno w rozwoju nowych funkcjonalności, integracji systemów, rolloutach, upgrade’ach, jak i uruchomieniach produkcyjnych.

To rola dla osoby, która dobrze odnajduje się na styku IT, systemów przemysłowych i integracji. Szukamy inżyniera, który rozumie środowisko produkcyjne, potrafi pracować z danymi i systemami MES oraz swobodnie porusza się w technicznych aspektach wdrożeń.

Pracujemy w pełni zdalnie, z możliwością korzystania z biur we Wrocławiu, Katowicach, Poznaniu i Gdańsku.

Dlaczego warto?

To rola, w której:

pracujesz przy rzeczywistych wdrożeniach MES w dużych zakładach produkcyjnych
uczestniczysz w międzynarodowych projektach związanych z cyfryzacją produkcji
rozwijasz kompetencje na styku IT, OT i systemów przemysłowych
masz kontakt z nowoczesnym środowiskiem AVEVA i rozwiązaniami klasy MES
pracujesz w projektach obejmujących różne etapy wdrożeń – od integracji po rollout i uruchomienie
zdobywasz doświadczenie w środowisku produkcyjnym o dużej skali i złożoności
współpracujesz z doświadczonymi specjalistami z obszaru MES, automatyki i integracji przemysłowych
masz możliwość rozwoju w kierunku architektury rozwiązań przemysłowych i cyfryzacji produkcji

Jeśli interesuje Cię praca blisko rzeczywistych procesów produkcyjnych i chcesz rozwijać się w obszarze systemów MES oraz integracji przemysłowych – ta rola będzie dobrym wyborem.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój, konfigurację i wdrażanie systemów MES opartych o technologie AVEVA
integrację systemów produkcyjnych z bazami danych, systemami SCADA, ERP i innymi źródłami danych
pracę z danymi procesowymi oraz rozwój logiki biznesowej systemów MES
rozwój i utrzymanie komponentów aplikacyjnych z wykorzystaniem technologii webowych i backendowych
tworzenie oraz rozwój zapytań i logiki w Microsoft SQL Server (T-SQL)
udział w rolloutach, uruchomieniach i działaniach wdrożeniowych w środowiskach produkcyjnych
współpracę z klientami przy analizie wymagań i rozwoju rozwiązań
wsparcie techniczne oraz troubleshooting systemów produkcyjnych
współpracę z zespołami projektowymi, automatykami i inżynierami po stronie klienta
udział w rozwoju standardów i najlepszych praktyk w obszarze MES i integracji przemysłowych

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz doświadczenie w pracy z systemami MES, SCADA
pracowałeś/aś z technologiami AVEVA / Wonderware lub podobnymi platformami przemysłowymi
dobrze rozumiesz integrację systemów IT/OT oraz środowiska produkcyjne
masz praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy z Microsoft SQL Server i T-SQL
potrafisz analizować i rozwiązywać problemy techniczne w złożonych środowiskach systemowych
znasz podstawy programowania i swobodnie poruszasz się w technologiach takich jak C#, JavaScript, SQL lub REST API

jobs.title: Senior Windows Endpoint Developer (Workforce AI Security)
jobs.description:
The Role

The Windows agent runs on hundreds of thousands of enterprise machines, enforcing data-loss policies and providing visibility over employee AI usage. The hard part isn’t standard application logic — it’s building deep systems-level software, privileged services, and network interception mechanisms that execute reliably across highly heterogeneous enterprise environments without breaking host operations. The role owns the Windows agent end-to-end, serving as the technical authority for the platform while engineering silent installation and updates, certificate trust and TLS interception, system proxy configuration, and seamless coexistence with third-party security software.

About The Product

The platform provides enterprise-wide visibility and governance over employee interactions with generative AI tools and developer environments. Operating at global enterprise scale, it monitors endpoint AI usage, enforces real-time DLP policies, and inspects network traffic directly on managed devices. The Windows agent must operate reliably across highly varied corporate environments, alongside existing antivirus, EDR, VPN, proxy, and device-management software, without disrupting users or corporate connectivity.

Technology Stack

The core endpoint architecture is built primarily in C# and C++, with Python and PowerShell powering tooling and automation. The Windows platform includes privileged Windows services, registry, COM, WMI, UAC and elevation, WinHTTP and WinInet, certificate stores, system proxy configuration, and browser integrations for Edge and Chrome. Network-level interception and inspection may involve Windows Filtering Platform and related system components. Shared cross-platform logic increasingly relies on Python and Rust.

Deployment and field execution are managed through enterprise tooling such as Intune, Configuration Manager, Group Policy, and Tanium. The engineering toolkit includes Visual Studio, MSI and InstallShield, WiX, signtool, WinDbg, Process Monitor, Process Explorer, Wireshark, Git, and GitHub Actions.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own the Windows agent end-to-end, leading architecture for privileged services, inter-process communication, installation, and unattended auto-update pipelines
Architect certificate trust and TLS interception on Windows, including correct handling of machine and user certificate stores, trust chains, and applications that resist interception
Design resilient state-reconciliation logic for system proxy configuration, including coexistence with VPN clients, cloud proxies, and other software competing for proxy state
Build deep integrations into AI developer tools such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code to inspect and govern local AI activity
Ensure reliable coexistence with antivirus, EDR, VPN, proxy, and other endpoint security products, fixing compatibility issues in the product rather than relying on customer-side exclusions
Drive field root-cause engineering, using logs, diagnostics, and evidence from real customer environments to turn recurring deployment and runtime failures into permanent product fixes
Own the Windows installation and update experience, including silent installation, upgrades, rollback scenarios, and enterprise deployment edge cases
Act as the definitive Windows technical owner, establishing engineering standards, conducting code reviews, and contributing to the technical direction of the agent
Help ensure the product follows a fail-open philosophy, with every error path designed to degrade gracefully rather than interrupt customer connectivity or access to corporate resources

What We Expect

Must-have

8+ years of systems-level development experience preferred, including strong production experience building Windows software or endpoint products. 5+ years may be considered for candidates with a strong security background
Deep, practical expertise in Windows internals and architecture — this is critical. The role requires someone who understands Windows at the system level, not just someone who has built applications for Windows
Professional-level C# proficiency is mandatory and will be the primary development language, with strong C++ systems experience
Proven production experience developing Windows software, endpoint agents, or security products
Deep foundational knowledge of Windows security architecture, including privileged services, registry, COM, WMI, UAC, elevation, and certificate management
Proven track record of owning endpoint features end-to-end, from technical decisions and architecture through implementation and production delivery
Ability to work independently and debug complex field issues without constant guidance or direct access to customer machines
Strong communication and collaboration skills, especially in a remote and cross-functional environment
CS degree or equivalent practical engineering background

Nice-to-have

In-depth expertise with Windows installer technologies such as MSI, InstallShield, or WiX, including custom actions, transforms, silent installation, upgrades, and rollback scenarios
Hands-on experience with enterprise deployment tooling such as Intune, Configuration Manager/SCCM, Group Policy, or Tanium
Experience troubleshooting antivirus and EDR coexistence, including understanding which endpoint behaviors and installer patterns commonly trigger security products
Strong knowledge of Windows certificate stores and code signing, including machine versus user stores, EV signing, and SmartScreen reputation
Production experience with TLS interception, trust-chain management, certificate pinning, and related edge cases
Experience with Windows Filtering Platform, network drivers, or kernel-mode components
Python or Rust experience
Hands-on experience with AI developer tooling such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code extensions, or Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Browser extension development for Edge or Chrome
Network traffic inspection or packet analysis experience
Previous experience at a cybersecurity vendor, particularly with DLP, CASB, EDR, or browser security products
macOS or cross-platform endpoint development experience

How The Team Works

Fail open, always. Nothing shipped may prevent a customer from browsing the internet or reaching corporate resources. Every error path should degrade gracefully
Fix the product, not the customer. When the agent conflicts with another vendor’s software, the engineering team owns the fix rather than asking the customer to add an exclusion
Read the logs before theorizing. Diagnosis starts with evidence from the actual machine, not assumptions
Tests are how the team ships confidently into environments it cannot log into. Reproducibility, diagnostics, and automated testing are essential to the development process

Team & Growth

You would join a small Windows-focused team with significant room to grow.
The current core team has two Windows developers and one macOS developer, with a plan to hire several additional Windows engineers.
The role itself is expected to remain focused on Windows development for at least the next 6–12 months, with the opportunity to have significant ownership as the team grows.

The project is part of the Credit, Asset-backed & Securitized Products (CASP) division of an investment bank, focusing on platforms that support securitization and structured finance products. jobs.title: Principal Architect
jobs.description:
What Makes Us, Us  

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!  

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT FOR US

SimCorp is investing in the integration layer of SimCorp One. We are looking for a Platform Test Architect to extend our platform capabilities for automated, repeatable cross-system testing, the crucial layer between system tests and end-to-end flows. Your work will enable product and platform teams to validate release candidates after the merge gate and qualify deliveries at scale across our service ecosystem.

You will work closely with our Application Test Architect to cover the full testing spectrum. In addition, you will collaborate with architects responsible for platform services, engineering pipelines, and infrastructure to ensure testing capabilities integrate seamlessly into our delivery processes. Your focus will be on platform capabilities and execution, while our Application Test Architect leads application-side practices and client-facing testing coordination. Together with other architects, you will close today’s gaps and establish modern, scalable testing as a first-class engineering concern.

What You Will Be Responsible For

To ensure success in this role, you will be involved in the following areas:

Integration testing platform: Design and deliver a shared platform for integration testing of SimCorp One services (Microsoft Azure, Azure Kubernetes Service, .NET), enabling teams to add, run, and automate cross-system tests efficiently and repeatedly.
Quality gates: Operationalize post-merge quality gates for release candidates, including contract and application programming interface testing, integration suites, sanity and smoke tests, and define the process for exceptions or waivers.
Drive requirements: Help standardize testing capabilities in our eco-system and define how systems can test integration patterns.
Adoption and enablement: Drive organization-wide adoption through templates, reference implementations, and recommended practices that teams can extend.
Test data and environments: Define the strategy for test data and environments, including synthetic data, data masking, and production-equivalent snapshots, in collaboration with our operations and platform teams.
Performance and load testing: Lay the groundwork for performance and load testing as a future phase, including tooling choices, service level agreements, and monitoring.
Documentation and alignment: Document and align at scale by authoring reference architecture documents, patterns, and playbooks; publishing via the Architecture Hub; and measuring adoption and impact.

Your role will be pivotal in ensuring that SimCorp remains an efficient, transparent leader in financial services, directly contributing to our strategic objectives and long-term success.

What We Value

To ensure success in this role, possessing one or more of the following skills will be highly beneficial:

Integration testing experience: Experience in building integration testing capabilities for service-based architectures at scale, ideally in a business-to-business or software-as-a-service context.
Cloud and platform expertise: Experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure Kubernetes Service; strong background in .NET.
Testing strategies: Knowledge of testing strategies, including black/grey/white box testing, consumer-driven contract testing, integration layering, pipeline governance, and quality gates.
Test data management: Practical experience with synthetic data approaches, data masking, and designing environments for testability.
Testing economy: Optimization of cost-of-testing, including experience with shift-left patterns and ability to formulate various tradeoffs when adhering to economic testing approaches.
Automation mindset: An automation-first mindset, with a track record of improving lead-time-for-changes, minimizing escaped defects, reducing failure rates, and increasing recovery speed.
Stakeholder management: Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive consensus across platform, application, Site Reliability Engineering, and product teams, and to remain resilient in complex or ambiguous situations.
Performance and security testing: Experience with performance and load testing, resilience testing, or security testing integration is a plus.
Compliance and best practices: Exposure to compliance frameworks such as Service Organization Control 2 (SOC2) or Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) is beneficial but not required.
Developer experience: Experience curating recommended practices and developer experience artifacts is valued.

These skills will empower you to contribute significantly to our service delivery strategy and help maintain the highest standards of communication and efficiency for our platforms and services.

How We Work

At SimCorp, we believe that our success is driven by the collaboration and innovation of our people. Here is what you can expect and what we hope you'll bring to our team:

Community leadership: You will be a key driver in the Testing Technical Collaboration Council, collaborating daily with platform and application architects, product owners, product managers, and value streams.
Decision rights and alignment: You will have architectural decision rights and ensure alignment with adjacent core areas, including security, compliance, Site Reliability Engineering, and product.
Testing review: As part of our architectural review of system and services, you will be responsible for reviewing the testing strategy of the system
Enablement and scaling: The role is focused on building foundations and guidelines for other teams to scale; documentation and alignment are essential.
Coaching and enablement: Parts of your time will be dedicated to the coaching and enablement of our Tech Leads and Engineering teams, with most of your time focused on architecture decisions and design.

Benefits   

Flexible working hours and hybrid model - 2 days in the office, 3 days remote
Modern office (next to Wilanowska metro station) with quiet zones and ergonomic workstations
Base salary with annual bonus structure 
Holiday allowance upon a 2-week vacation
Occasional remote work across Poland and international options available (up to 24 days domestic, 20 days international per year - subject to internal policy)
Employer-paid Medicover Platinum healthcare package (employee-paid family upgrade available)
Multisport card with 75% employer contribution
Unum group life insurance (employee-paid upgrade available)
Medicover travel insurance for private trips and global business travel insurance
Possibility to join Deutsche Börse Group Share Plan (eligible after 1 year)
Copyrights program for certain roles 
Possibility to develop your career in an international environment
Professional training and courses provided by SimCorp
Polish language classes for foreign employees; German and English classes based on business needs
Integration events, volunteering initiatives and employee-led clubs

NEXT STEPS 

Please click below to apply to learn more about the vacancy and what SimCorp has to offer regarding salary, benefits, and perks. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process, we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

jobs.title: .NET-utvecklare till riskbedömning
jobs.description:
Att jobba som . NET utvecklare

Vill du utveckla moderna försäkringslösningar och samtidigt få möjlighet att påverka både teknik och arbetssätt?

Hos oss blir du en del av ett erfaret team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och dialog är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du får arbeta nära verksamheten och användarna, vilket ger dig snabb återkoppling på det du utvecklar och möjlighet att se hur dina lösningar används i praktiken.

Här får du dessutom vara med i en spännande teknisk förflyttning. Vi har lanserat den första versionen av vårt nya riskbedömningssystem och fortsätter nu utvecklingen samtidigt som äldre lösningar successivt ersätts.

Därför kan det här vara jobbet för dig:

Du får kombinera nyutveckling och förvaltning och följa lösningar hela vägen från kod till produktion.
Du arbetar med verksamhetskritiska lösningar som bland annat används för digital hälsodeklaration och medicinsk riskbedömning.
Du får arbeta i ett erfaret team med nära samarbete och frekvent feedback från verksamheten.
Du får möjlighet att bredda din kompetens mellan .NET och React, oavsett om din tyngdpunkt idag ligger inom backend eller frontend.
Du har flera möjliga utvecklingsvägar framåt, exempelvis mot systemansvar, Scrum Master eller mjukvaruarkitektur.

Som .NET-utvecklare arbetar du med utveckling och förvaltning av applikationerna i teamets portfölj. En viktig del är vår digitala hälsodeklaration och vårt riskbedömningssystem med regelmotor och handläggarstöd. Rollen innebär att du successivt bygger upp förståelse för helheten och tar ansvar för lösningarna även efter att de gått i produktion.

Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Är Att

utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar i .NET och React
arbeta med felsökning, incidenthantering och förvaltning
testa din egen kod och delta aktivt i code reviews
hantera release och deploy samt arbeta med Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy
arbeta med SQL, integrationer och teamets olika applikationer
samarbeta med bland annat riskbedömare, processägare och andra utvecklingsteam
bidra med idéer, feedback och problemlösning tillsammans med dina kollegor.

Vi är 8 personer i teamet som består av bland annat utvecklare, testare, Product Owner, Scrum Master och mjukvaruarkitekt. Vi utgår från vårt huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm och arbetar hybrid, med en kombination av arbete på kontoret och på distans. Du rapporterar till gruppchef IT inom IT Risk & Hälsa.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig med omkring fem års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och som relativt snabbt kan bidra i teamets leveranser. Du har erfarenhet av .NET-utveckling och gärna React, men det viktiga är att du är nyfiken på helheten och vill utvecklas över gränserna mellan frontend och backend.

Du behöver kunna kommunicera väl på svenska i tal och skrift. Kunskaper inom SQL, Azure DevOps, CI/CD och releasehantering eller motsvarande är värdefulla eftersom du arbetar med hela utvecklingskedjan. Erfarenhet från försäkringsbranschen är meriterande.

Som person är du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och problemlösningsorienterad med förmåga att självständigt planera ditt arbete. Du söker orsaken när problem uppstår och tar dem vidare till en lösning, vilket är viktigt i arbetet med nyutveckling, förvaltning, felsökning och incidenthantering.

Samarbete och kommunikation är en naturlig del av rollen. Du delar kunskap, lyfter frågor och kan ge och ta emot feedback på ett konstruktivt sätt. Vi uppskattar också din nyfikenhet och vilja att sätta dig in i nya områden och förstå helheten.

Vad händer nu?

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef (namn på chefen) på (mailadress).

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med rekryterande chef Patric Wu via patric.wu@skandia.se eller Talent Acquisition Partner på madelene.skogh@skandia.se.

Vi kommer att återkoppla till alla som söker oavsett om du går vidare eller inte.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of business and technology, helping our organisation move from manual and fragmented ways of working towards connected, scalable, and transparent processes.
As a Process Integration Specialist, you will help analyse business processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and design and implement automation and integrations that create measurable value.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, IT, and global automation teams. Your ability to understand both business challenges and technical possibilities will be essential in turning requirements into robust solutions.
We believe technology should support people, reduce repetitive work, and augment human decision-making. You will therefore play an important role in making sure our automation solutions are practical, reliable, and user-focused.

Analyse and describe end-to-end and sub-processes across service, finance, order-to-cash, logistics, and support functions.
Identify opportunities to simplify, optimise, standardise, and automate processes.
Design, build, and maintain automated workflows and integrations using Microsoft Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Azure Logic Apps, SharePoint Agents, and related Microsoft technologies.
Translate business needs into clear functional and technical specifications, including data structures (XML/JSON), interfaces and exception handling.
Create and maintain high-quality documentation covering process designs, automation logic, integrations, and operational procedures.
Act as a bridge between business stakeholders, IT, and global automation teams, ensuring solutions align with architecture, security, and governance requirements.
Support integrations with external systems and business partners, including procurement and ordering technologies such as cXML, OCI, and Peppol.
Proactively challenge manual, repetitive, and error-prone ways of working and contribute to a continuous improvement and automation mindset across the organisation.
Help ensure that automation delivers tangible business value while maintaining quality, compliance, and a positive user experience.

You will ideally have

Proven experience in process optimisation, automation, process integration, or a similar role, ideally within a B2B service or operations environment.
Strong knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem, particularly Power Automate, Power Automate Desktop, Copilot Studio, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and SharePoint Agents.
Good understanding of data formats and integration concepts, including XML, JSON, APIs, and REST principles.
Experience analysing and improving business processes and workflows.

Experience working with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
A natural curiosity and a mindset of continuously asking: “Is there a better way to do this?”
The ability to influence, guide, and challenge stakeholders without relying on formal management authority.
A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field is an advantage. Equivalent professional experience is also highly relevant.

Who will thrive in this role?

You are someone who is naturally curious, structured, and pragmatic. You enjoy digging into a process to understand what is really happening, not just what the process documentation says.
You can move comfortably between a conversation with a business user about a frustrating manual task and a technical discussion about APIs, data structures, integrations, or automation architecture.
You don't just ask “Can we automate this?” You ask “Should we automate this, what value will it create, and what is the best way to do it?”
If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Someone built an agent on their laptop. It works well enough that they use it every day. It also reads sensitive data and sends it to a model outside the company, and nobody in IT knows it is there.

Shadow AI like this is spreading fast. The usual reaction is to hunt these agents down and switch them off. We would rather make them possible.

Arc Theory builds the platform that makes that possible. We work with companies that want AI running in production, with the governance and security to hold up under audit. That means the agent runtime, how agents are operated and governed, and the road from an idea to something people can rely on. We are a small senior team in Stockholm, founded in 2026 by Björn Eriksen, who led solutions architect teams at Microsoft and AWS, and Marcus Falck, who founded a SaaS company and ran it as CTO for ten years. Arc Theory is backed by Zefyr Development, a venture developer that starts and scales specialist consultancies. We are now expanding the team.

What you would do

You would work with Swedish companies that have the ambition and the pilots, and nothing dependable in production yet. In one week you might sketch an architecture on a whiteboard, sit with a CIO, and then spend two days beside the client's own architects and developers building it.

A good part of the job is not technical. Organisations change when people change how they work, and someone has to bring the client's engineers with them.

What you bring

An ideal candidate is a senior solutions architect with years of hands-on cloud experience, building on Azure, AWS or Google Cloud, with real depth in at least one. With that comes an understanding of what an autonomous process can reach when nobody is watching, what the damage is when it gets something wrong, and how anyone would know its answers are good.

You also bring a working foundation in AI, enough to reason about how models and agents behave once they are in production. We are deliberately not listing frameworks here. We would rather meet people who arrived at this from different directions.

You do not need to have run AI agents in production. Almost nobody has yet. You want to be among the first who do.

Inside Arc Theory we work in English, so fluency in written and spoken English is a requirement. Swedish is a plus, as some client assignments might require it.

What makes you more interesting to us: a background in consulting, experience of security and governance, and what you learned taking something past the pilot stage.

Who we are looking for

This is the right job for someone who wants a say in what Arc Theory becomes. The first hires decide how the work is done here, and we would rather work that out with you than hand you a method. You would be the one who notices the pattern worth reusing on the next engagement. And good people tend to follow people they have worked with, so we would be glad if some of them followed you.

Pay

A fixed base salary, plus a variable part that grows with the hours you bill.

The total is yours to shape. You decide how it is paid out between salary, pension and benefits, and you can change that as your life changes.

Practical

Stockholm, hybrid. You decide where you work best, except when an engagement needs you at the client.

Apply here on LinkedIn, or write to me directly at bjorn.eriksen@arctheory.se. No cover letter needed. We start with a conversation. Questions before you apply are welcome at the same address.

Björn Eriksen, CEO, Arc Theory

We already have the recruitment support we need, so no agency pitches or ad sales, please.

jobs.description:
Most people have never heard of the technologies behind the products they use every day. Chances are, they've relied on ours.

Our software and development tools help build products used in cars, hospitals, factories, homes, and industries around the world. We help engineers solve complex challenges and create technology people can depend on.

Rooted in Nordic values and trusted by innovators worldwide, we combine deep technical expertise with a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and collaboration. With decades of engineering experience and a shared passion for technical excellence, we're helping shape the future of software and embedded development.

We take pride in building tools for people who build the world around us.

About the Role

IAR is part of Qt Group, operating as an independent business focused on embedded software development. We provide software development tools that help engineers develop, debug, test, and secure embedded software for products across automotive, industrial automation, medical technology, and other industries.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer for the team that owns IAR's license management platform. It’s the system that lets customers access and run IAR's software tools, whether through a cloud-based, subscription-ready platform or on-premises. The team works across the full stack, from the client software installed on developers' machines to the services and infrastructure behind it.

As a Software Engineer, you'll take ownership of the license client components used across IAR's product portfolio, while getting exposure to the wider platform and plenty of room to grow in the direction that interests you.

What You’ll Do

Develop and maintain the license client software used across IAR's products to access and validate licenses.
Support and evolve our cloud-based, subscription licensing platform alongside our on-premises offering.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the client and backend services, including occasional work in our license back-office systems.
Collaborate closely with the rest of the team on architecture, priorities, and technical decisions.
Get involved in wider platform work, including web services, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.

What You Bring to the Table

Professional experience in C++ software development.
Automation and scripting skills in Python or similar languages.
Experience building or integrating web services and APIs.
Comfortable working across both Windows and Linux environments.
Experience with containerized development using Docker.
Good communication skills in English.

Bonus Points For...

Exposure to cloud technologies (e.g. Azure), microservices, or Kubernetes
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, Git/GitLab, or Artifactory.
Experience with C# and/or Java, useful for our license back-office and integration services.

Build What Matters. Grow Where It Matters.

We believe work should support your life, not the other way around. That's why our benefits are designed to be flexible, inclusive, and meaningful across every stage of your journey. From wellbeing and growth to celebrating life's big (and small) moments, we invest in what matters to you, wherever you are.

Flexibility You Can Count On

We offer hybrid working options and flexible hours, empowering you to balance your personal life and professional goals because life outside of work matters, too.

Meaningful Wellbeing Support

From mental health resources to physical wellness programs, we provide practical, accessible support tailored to local needs.

Opportunities to Grow

Whether through hands-on learning, mentorship, or international collaboration, we invest in your development so your career can grow in the direction you choose.

Inclusive by Design

You'll join a team that values different perspectives, encourages collaboration, and creates space for everyone to contribute and succeed.

Rewarding Your Impact

Our compensation and benefits packages are competitive, regularly reviewed, and locally relevant, ensuring your contribution is recognized wherever you are.

Bring Your Whole Self

The best ideas come from people with different experiences, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, supported, and able to do their best work.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities and provide equal opportunities for all. Our technology may be what we're known for, but it's our people who make the difference.

We'd love to learn more about you. Tell us about your skills and experience, but just as importantly, tell us what motivates you and what kind of impact you want to make.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Architect to join our Architecture team. This is an opportunity to contribute to the design and architecture of our cloud-based platform using the latest technology advancements and methodologies. You will work closely with cross BU Engineering and Product teams to ensure implementation aligns with architectural designs to deliver enterprise solutions to our customers at scale. An appreciation for Technological risks and articulation of Non-functional requirements is required. Excellent communication and teamwork skills are expected alongside a strong work ethic and a can-do attitude.

You will have strong experience with the Microsoft Tech Stack and associated infrastructure and how it applies to DevOps and Security. You will have a keen interest in doing things the right way and for taking on new challenges.

While this role primarily involves Solution Architecture, it is expected that the candidate also has strong development skills and can help deliver on some core Platform offerings.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Microsoft technologies and familiarity with other Cloud Platform offerings. As a Software Architect, you will participate in architectural and key decision-making forums regarding choice of technologies, design approaches and Product roadmap. You will maintain a strong focus on the reliability, performance and security of our platform centred around a positive customer experience.

What You Will Do

Work with Product and Engineering Management to define the Product Roadmap and associated designs / technical enablers.
Facilitate implementation of a cloud-based platform that is secure, cost efficient, reliable, performant & scalable.
Define and maintain software architecture standards and best practices.
Lead the design and implementation of scalable and secure software solutions
Communicate NFR’s and designs effectively both formally and verbally.
Identify and help to reduce any Strategic Technical Debt.
Collaborate with development teams to ensure alignment with architectural goals and solution designs.
Evaluate and recommend tools, technologies, and processes to ensure the highest quality products for our platform.
Provide technical direction and mentoring to development teams.
Actively contribute to the development of core platform packages/template projects.
Keep abreast of the latest technological advancements that will help us to continuously improve our platform offering.
Partner with Architecture, DevOps and Platform Engineering teams to automate deployments, enforce governance, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements
Ensure data security, privacy, and compliance with all applicable policies and standards.

What You Bring

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum of 8 years development experience.
3+ years of experience working in a Software, Technical or Solution Architecture role.
Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures and design patterns.
Exposure to design/build of reliable distributed enterprise systems capable of scaling to serve high volumes of traffic.
High attention to detail and willingness to take on complex technical challenges.
Proficiency in the Microsoft stack - .Net (c#), Web Api, Azure Services (inclu. Cosmos, Azure Sql, App Insights, Key Vault, AFD, etc.), Azure Devops, etc.
Familiarity with GCP offerings such as GKE, Postgres, and Cloud Functions.
Experience/Knowledge of JavaScript/Typescript Frameworks such as Angular and React.
Full understanding of the SDLC, with experience working with DDD, TDD, CI/CD.
Experience in Event Driven Architecture, Microservices, Kafka.
Exposure to Container Technology (Kubernetes, Docker, etc.)
Microsoft Azure / .Net certification an advantage.
Use of Co-Pilot/Other for AI design & coding efficiency gains.
A keen interest in AI technologies and tooling and how they can be leveraged by teams to accelerate Delivery and value to the business and our customers.
Intellectual curiosity and learning ability.
Excellent communication, documentation, design and stakeholder management skills.

Over 5,000 customers across 23 countries already benefit from our Performance Sustainability software, ensuring we deliver practical solutions for improved profitability and environmental resilience across the globe.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Ecommerce
jobs.description:
About Phorest

Phorest is a growing tech company on a mission to help beauty businesses thrive. Our software empowers premium salons, spas, and aesthetic clinics around the globe with a suite of tools designed to enhance client experiences, streamline operations, and drive business growth. With a presence in the heart of the beauty industry, we are committed to fostering innovation, excellence, and community. At Phorest, we don’t just build software – we build success stories.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a new Engineering Manager to join our Ecommerce team within the Consumer Group. You will join a team who are responsible for building and maintaining Online Booking Platform as well as other consumer products such as online gift vouchers, branded applications and the online store where clients can sell their retail products conveniently. These products are built using technologies including React Native, Ruby & Java.

For this role, you will have the opportunity to be hands-on but instinctively focus on ensuring your team is set up for success first by removing any blockers. You will be a key member of this team, collaborating with the other engineers and facilitating the day-to-day running of the team. You will be responsible for growing, coaching and motivating a team of engineers to reach their own, and in turn Phorest’s goals. You will work closely with the Product Manager and Designer on the team to shape the strategy and also collaborate with other teams where there is a crossover of domains.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who wants a new challenge, where you’ll bring your experience to a supportive, growth mindset environment that will enable us to achieve our goals. You will join a multidisciplinary group of technology, product and design folks in building the future of the hair and beauty industry.

What You'll Do

Be responsible for leading the Ecommerce team within the Consumer domain of our product, including their overall health, productivity and impact.
Work with Engineering Managers, Product Leads and other key stakeholders to understand and shape the overarching consumer strategy.
Work with your team to ensure an appropriate balance of new capabilities and technical maintenance is being carried out within each development cycle so that the technical health of the platform is conserved as the platform evolves
Help identify bottlenecks within the team, improve working processes, and ensure software delivery best practices are being used to our advantage
Track the progress outwards to the wider teams, ensuring new capabilities are released on time and to the required quality standards
Champion the observability strategy within your team ensuring relevant service level objectives(SLOs) are set to measure and improve the e-commerce system’s reliability. Your team will have the correct monitoring tooling in place and proactively identify and address issues.
Drive a culture of quality within the team by establishing rigorous processes and methodologies. This will include maintaining high code quality standards, defining and implementing automated testing strategies and ensuring comprehensive test coverage for both new features and existing functionality.
There is going to be hands-on work here, as a leader of this team you are going to need to understand how things work, there will be times when you will need to contribute to the team's work, review code and support them in designing and building complex distributed systems. You’ll help guide your team to design technical solutions that are appropriate in terms of scale, resilience and reliability.
Have direct people management responsibilities for a scrum team. This will require you to:
Have regular 1 to 1s with each person to ensure they are happy and engaged in their work, as well as to coach them through any problems they are wrestling with
Provide regular feedback and periodic performance reviews
Understand each person’s long-term aspirations, helping them to set goals and carve out opportunities for growth in their career that are aligned with those goals

Attend regular Product and Engineering management meetings, where you will have the opportunity to influence decisions that affect the entire engineering group
Report to the Head of Engineering of the Consumer group providing regular updates on progress and strategy while sharing any challenges the team may be facing where support is required.
Help build our engineering brand by both talking about and sharing blog posts on the amazing work we do

Who You Are

3+ years demonstrated impact in a similar leadership role, with hands-on experience managing people
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a similar related field
Strong proficiency and at least 5 years of professional experience with object-oriented software design, primarily Java
The ability to collaboratively lead the evolution of your team’s strategy, setting unambiguous roadmaps and goals for the team and then delivering on them in a healthy, predictable and sustainable way
You should be comfortable coaching team members. You will communicate expectations clearly and deliver individual feedback frequently
You have a proven history of building close working relationships with your product counterparts and external stakeholders, with the ability to inspire and motivate, improve quality and productivity, while maintaining technical innovation and excellence
Strategic thinker, with an ability to express and convey thoughts in meaningful ways in a fast-paced and evolving environment, with a high degree of autonomy
Previous hands-on development experience with complex distributed systems
Experience working with and managing Agile teams, as well as driving improvement across the whole development process
Experience developing and supporting engineers in their personal growth and career progression. You foster an environment where communication, teamwork, and collaboration are rewarded
You’ll focus on quality, while increasing efficiency, delivering value and reducing waste

Benefits

🧘 Your wellbeing is important to us - we provide private healthcare, 2 Wellness Days, an employee assistance program and a free online GP service.

💰 As part of our Financial Wellbeing, we provide competitive Compensation, an Employee Share Purchase Scheme, Pension, Life Assurance, and Income Protection.

🚵🏿 We help you travel by providing a bike to work scheme as well as tax saver transport tickets.

🦸‍♀️ We support the women who work in Phorest by offering 2 weeks leave for Fertility Treatment, Pregnancy Loss and Menopause.

🍼 We care for your family and provide Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Benefits.

🌳 We grow our own timber! We provide a great learning environment and extensive development opportunities. We run development programs and provide access to many online resources including LinkedIn learning.

🏠 Moving house? Phorest employees get 3 moving days.

Want to learn more about Phorest? Check out nothingventured.rocks for our blog and Insights on building an evergreen company from the team here at Phorest.

Phorest is an equal opportunity employer.
For this position, flexi-time and working from home is possible. We are also open to remote work. Get in touch to ask for more information or to chat about your future with Phorest!

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalised folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

jobs.title: .NET utvikler
jobs.description:
Fra solid .NET-utvikling til praktisk AI: vil du være med fra starten?

Handelshøyskolen BI
er Norges største handelshøyskole og en selveid stiftelse med et tydelig samfunnsoppdrag. Vår forskning og utdanning bidrar til å løse samfunnets største utfordringer. Vi gir virksomheter kunnskapen de trenger for å lykkes, og mennesker muligheten til å bygge meningsfylte karrierer.

Endringstakten i samfunnet, teknologisk utvikling, KI, cybersikkerhet og nye forventninger fra studenter, spesielt etter pandemien krever en klar digital strategi. Derfor har vi de siste årene jobbet strategisk med å utvikle BI Digital som består av rundt 80 ansatte som er organisert i ulike produkt-team og som både bygger videre på markedsledende SaaS løsninger og egenutviklede og egenforvaltede løsninger.

Digitalavdelingen ved Handelshøyskolen BI utvikler tjenester som skaper en sømløs digital hverdag for våre 24 000 studenter, 1 000 ansatte og 300 000+alumni.

Nyopprettet initiativ og nyopprettede stillinger

BI har etablert en tverrfaglig AI Enabler Group (AEG) for å akselerere bruk av kunstig intelligens i hele organisasjonen. Vi samarbeider med forskningsmiljøer, undervisningsmiljøer og administrative avdelinger for å identifisere muligheter, gjennomføre pilotprosjekter og bidra til at vellykkede initiativer tas videre i organisasjonen. Målet er å bygge varig AI-kompetanse og styrke BIs evne til å ta i bruk kunstig intelligens på tvers av organisasjonen.

Vi skal nå rekruttere to hands-on og rådgivende utviklere med solid .NET erfaring og AI interesse til å bli med på denne spennende reisen sammen med oss.

Rollene

Som AI-utvikler vil du få en sentral rolle i BIs videre digitale utvikling. Du vil jobbe med å utforske, prototype og utvikle løsninger basert på generativ AI, LLM-er, RAG, søk, dokumentbehandling, integrasjoner og agentbaserte arbeidsflyter.

Du vil samarbeide tett med produktteam, arkitekter, utviklere og fagmiljøer for å forstå behov, teste hypoteser og bygge løsninger som kan tas videre fra idé til praktisk bruk. I rollen vil du også vurdere AI-verktøy og rammeverk opp mot BIs behov, arkitektur og krav til sikkerhet, personvern og etterlevelse, bidra til tekniske standarder og beste praksis, støtte overgangen fra eksperiment til produksjon og dele erfaringer på tvers av organisasjonen.

Du vil blant annet jobbe med

Microsoft Azure og Azure AI Foundry
Azure OpenAI og moderne språkmodeller
.NET/C# og API-utvikling
Designe og bygge løsninger basert på språkmodeller (LLM-er), RAG, agenter, søk, dokumentbehandling og automatisering
Integrasjoner mot BIs systemlandskap
CI/CD og moderne DevOps-praksis

Rollene er 100 % dedikert til AEG, men du vil samtidig være en del av Digital og inngå i et sterkt fagmiljø med utviklere, arkitekter og produktledere. Avhengig av initiativer og behov kan du også bidra i prioriterte utviklingsprosjekter utenfor de rene KI-løsningene.

Du vil også spille en viktig rolle i å bygge bro mellom eksperimentering og produksjon, og bidra til at vellykkede AI-initiativer kan skaleres og skape verdi i organisasjonen. For den rette kandidaten vil det være mulighet til å få et særskilt faglig lederansvar som Tech Lead eller lignende og bidra til å forme den tekniske retningen for AI-satsingen på BI.

Hvem er du?

Du er en utvikler med sterk teknisk forståelse, nysgjerrighet og evne til å lære raskt. Du trenger ikke nødvendigvis å ha jobbet lenge med AI, men du bør ha interesse for teknologien og helst ha testet ut AI-verktøy i utviklingsarbeid eller egne prosjekter. Du er initiativrik, selvdreven og trives med å samarbeide tett med både tekniske og ikke-tekniske miljøer.

Vi ser etter deg som har:

Solid erfaring med programvareutvikling innen .NET/C#, skyplattformer og integrasjoner
Erfaring med eller sterk interesse for generativ AI, språkmodeller, RAG, agenter eller tilsvarende AI-teknologier
Evne til å bygge prototyper, teste nye ideer og gjøre teknologi praktisk anvendbar
Erfaring med smidige utviklingsmetoder og tverrfaglige team
Høyere utdanning innen datateknologi, IT, informatikk eller tilsvarende
Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk

Vi er opptatt av å finne de rette menneskene. Det viktigste er ikke hvor lenge du har jobbet med AI, men at du har solid .NET utviklingskompetanse, lærelyst og evne til å omsette ny teknologi til løsninger som skaper verdi i praksis med spesielt fokus på AI. Du har faglig trygghet til å kvalitetssikre og videreutvikle løsninger som bygges med støtte fra AI. Du trives med komplekse problemstillinger, arbeider selvstendig og evner å kommunisere tekniske avveininger til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter.

Hva kan vi tilby?

Nyopprettede stillinger med stor påvirkningskraft hvor du kan være med å forme egen rolle
Muligheten til å være med på å bygge opp et nytt AI-miljø og påvirke hvordan kunstig intelligens tas i bruk ved en av Nordens ledende handelshøyskoler med stor innflytelse på fremtidens arbeidsliv
En solid og trygg arbeidsplass, i en virksomhet som investerer betydelig i digitale tjenester hvor du vil følge løsningene du er med på å skape over tid, og få tid til å fordype deg i våre produkter og en spennende sektor.
Du får dyktige fagfolk rundt deg å lære av, gode utviklingsmuligheter, deriblant kurs og muligheter for gratis videreutdanning.
Og ja, hos oss får du en fleksibel og familievennlig arbeidshverdag med fokus på balanse mellom jobb og privatliv, deriblant fri i romjulen og påskeuken i tillegg til fem ukers ferie.
Konkurransedyktige betingelser samt gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

Høres dette spennende ut?

Da håper vi du sender oss din CV i dag og noen ord om hvorfor du er interessert og passer.

Er du egentlig ikke på utkikk etter ny jobb, men ble nysgjerrig og vil vite mer, er du velkommen til å ta kontakt med vår rekrutteringspartner i Glasspaper People, Marianne Støen på telefon 920 35 260 og Thomas Schibbye på telefon 410 43 853.

Om Handelshøyskolen BI

Handelshøyskolen BI er en privat, uavhengig og internasjonalt akkreditert institusjon for forskning og høyere utdanning innenfor økonomi og ledelse. Med trippel akkreditering (EQUIS, AMBA, AACSB), en bred forskningsportefølje, 1.000 ansatte, 20.000 studenter og 300.000 alumni, er BI blant Europas ledende handelshøyskoler.

BIs Strategi 2030 har definert tydelige mål for å sikre at skolen leverer kunnskap som forandrer gjennom førsteklasses forskning og enestående læringsopplevelser. Dette gir virksomheter innsikt for å lykkes og enkeltpersoner muligheten til å bygge meningsfulle karrierer.
BIs hovedcampus ligger i Oslo, med tilleggscampuser i Bergen, Stavanger og Trondheim.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Vil du jobbe med betalingsflyt og bankintegrasjoner i et ledende ERP-system?

Vi søker en erfaren Software Engineer som vil være med å ta ansvar for betalingsløsninger og integrasjoner i systemet. Du jobber i kryssfunksjonelle team, tett på Product Manager, og får påvirke utvikling av produktet i et miljø med globale ambisjoner.

Teknologistacken vår inkluderer blant annet .NET/C#, MS SQL Server, React, Clojurescript og TypeScript. Hovedspråket for programmering er C#.

Kommer du fra et stort selskap og savner korte beslutningsveier? Hos oss er du tett på kunden, påvirker produktet og ser effekten av koden din - hver dag.

Dine hovedoppgaver

Designe, utvikle og drifte sikre betalingsflyter og API-integrasjoner mellom Xledger og banker/betalingsleverandører
Videreutvikle og nyutvikle funksjonalitet i ERP-systemet
Utvikle og vedlikeholde backend- og fullstack-løsninger med høy kvalitet
Sikre ytelse og robusthet gjennom testautomatisering og performance-forbedringer
Etterleve relevante standarder og regulatoriske krav (ISO 20022, PSD2), personvern og revisjonsspor
Samarbeide tett med Product Manager, DevOps og sikkerhet, samt veilede yngre utviklere

Vi ser etter deg som

Har 3-10 års erfaring med betalingsløsninger, gjerne innen bank og finans
Faglig sterk, og minimum bachelor innen informatikk eller tilsvarende
Behersker C#, .NET og SQL (T-SQL), og har solid erfaring med API- integrasjoner
Kjenner til/er nysgjerrig på regulatoriske rammeverk og standarder som PSD2 og ISO 20022
Er selvgående, samarbeidsorientert, ansvarlig og deler kunnskap – gjerne som mentor for andre
Kommuniserer godt på norsk og engelsk

Det er et pluss hvis du også har

Kjennskap til økonomi, regnskap eller lønn
Interesse for å jobbe med forretningskritiske systemer

Tilleggsinformasjon om teamet som jobber med betaling og integrasjoner

Teamet består av en Product Manager med solid domenekunnskap som har ansvar for spesifisering av behov og løsninger. I tillegg består teamet av to utviklere som er faglig dyktige, men fortsatt relativt tidlig i karrieren.
Det vil også være mulighet for å ta en Team Lead-rolle, ettersom nåværende Team Lead etter hvert skal videre til nye utfordringer. Rollen innebærer blant annet:
Ha oversikt over teamets arbeidsflyt: Prioriter oppgaver, vurder kompleksitet og sikre fremdrift.
Vurdere tekniske løsninger: Analysere om en oppgave kan løses, foreslå tilnærming og spesifikasjon.
Veilede og utvikle juniors: Bidra til faglig vekst, dele kunnskap og sikre høy kvalitet i leveranser.
Delta aktivt i utvikling og koding: Jobbe hands-on og sette standard for teamets tekniske arbeid.

Et miljø hvor du trives på jobb

Hos Xledger får du mer enn en spennende rolle. Du blir en del av et inspirerende teknologimiljø der utvikling, trivsel og samhold står i sentrum. Vi har faglig dyktige kolleger og et uformelt, hyggelig miljø der kunnskap deles og samarbeid verdsettes.
Vi legger stor vekt på sosiale aktiviteter og morsomme fellesopplevelser, alt fra Escape Room og Hemsedal-tur, til minigolf, bordtennisturnering, musikkbingo, strikkeklubb og buldreturer. Dette gir gode muligheter til å bli kjent på tvers av team og bygge et sterkt fellesskap.
Dette er en unik mulighet til å bruke kompetansen din på nye måter og sette spor i utviklingen av våre ERP-løsninger. Vi har gode onboardingsrutiner og sørger for at du får en solid start hos oss.
Klar for å søke?
Søk allerede i dag! Vi vurderer kandidater fortløpende. Lurer du på om rollen passer for deg? Kontakt Seniorrådgiver i Cruit, Stig Aulid Tlf 915 16 107 for en uforpliktende prat. Vi vet at ingen kandidater er like. Hvis du tror du kan bidra hos oss, hører vi gjerne fra deg!

Om selskapet

Xledger er ERP-systemet for ambisiøse selskaper som vil jobbe smartere, raskere og tryggere. En komplett, skybasert økonomiplattform klar til bruk. Få sanntidsinnsikt på tvers av selskaper og land. Skaler i takt med selskapets utvikling og la kunstig intelligens effektivisere prosesser i et system som alltid lærer.

Vi er et Software selskap som utvikler og leverer et av markedets mest avanserte skybaserte ERP-systemer. Hos oss får du en unik mulighet til å gjøre en konkret forskjell for tusenvis av brukere i over 60 land - ved å gjøre kompleks teknologi forståelig og tilgjengelig. Sammen bygger vi løsninger som forenkler hverdagen for økonomer, ledere og organisasjoner. Xledger er et av de mest funksjonsrike økonomisystemene i markedet (multi-tenant public cloud). Systemet utvikles kontinuerlig til det beste for brukerne.

Vi har kontorer i Norge, USA, England, Sverige, Finland og Danmark, og er ca. 300 ansatte globalt (ca. 180 befinner seg i Norge ved Oslo-kontoret).

jobs.title: Digital Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Tana Oy is a Finnish environmental technology company founded in 1971. We are one of the leading developers and providers of mobile equipment and solutions for solid waste management focusing on waste treatment companies and waste yards.

The company slogan is TANA From Waste to Value®. We not only produce the best fit-for-purpose machines designed to reduce the environmental impact of waste, but also provide tailored life cycle services, supported by a strong local presence and expertise. Our commitment to sustainability and core competence in innovative R&D ensure that we not only meet but exceed industry standards, delivering efficient solutions to our customers worldwide. Nowadays TANA machines are exported to more than 50 countries.

Are you inspired by connected machines, digital services and turning data into practical customer value? In this role, you will play an important part in developing Tana’s digital services portfolio, including TanaConnect, eSpares and future AI-enabled solutions.

Your responsibilities: 

As a Digital Solutions Engineer, you act as the link between business needs, solution users and software development teams. You ensure that digital solutions meet customer needs, support Tana’s long-term vision and deliver measurable value throughout their lifecycle.

You coordinate day-to-day cooperation with our digital development partners, including sprint activities, requirement clarification and development follow-up. You monitor progress and quality, ensure that agreed requirements are met and escalate technical, schedule or resource-related risks when needed.

You gather and analyze requirements from customers, dealers and Tana internal teams and translate them into clear technical specifications. You maintain development backlogs, coordinate acceptance testing and validate delivered functionality against the agreed requirements.

You support the continuous development of TanaConnect and other customer- and dealer-facing digital services. You contribute to the implementation of approved roadmap initiatives and releases and drive continuous improvement across the digital service lifecycle.

You also participate in the development of data-driven services, analytics and AI-enabled solutions. This includes initiatives related to predictive maintenance, intelligent reporting and machine performance monitoring, as well as evaluating new technologies and development opportunities.

In this role, you collaborate closely with customers, dealers, internal stakeholders and external partners in digitalization, integration and AI projects. Through your work, you help ensure that business needs, technical development and customer value remain aligned.

What we expect from you: 

We are looking for a technically minded professional with relevant education in software engineering, information technology, automation, data engineering or another related field. Equivalent practical experience may also provide a strong foundation for succeeding in the role.

You have previous experience in digital services, software products, industrial IoT solutions or a similar environment. You understand requirements engineering, backlog management, testing and release coordination, and are familiar with agile software development practices.

You have a good understanding of cloud services, APIs, integrations and data platforms. Experience in coordinating external development partners and working with multiple stakeholders is important.

Experience in fleet management, telematics, industrial IoT, mobile machinery, industrial equipment or heavy-duty vehicle environments is considered an advantage. Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Power BI, Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps or similar platforms is also beneficial. Experience in AI, machine learning, data analytics or predictive maintenance solutions would further support your success in the role.

You work systematically and take ownership of development topics, while remaining able to prioritize and respond pragmatically when requirements, schedules or technical circumstances change. You communicate clearly, cooperate effectively with different stakeholders and approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset. Fluency in written and spoken English is required; Finnish is considered an advantage.

What we offer: 

You will become part of a skilled and collaborative R&D organization, where your work will directly influence how Tana’s connected machines and digital services evolve and create value for customers.

The position gives you the opportunity to broaden your expertise across industrial IoT, cloud technologies, data analytics and AI in an international technology company. You will work closely with engineering professionals, software development partners and stakeholders across the business, providing a wide perspective on both our products and customer needs.

Our culture is practical, open and collaborative, with a shared commitment to moving ideas into action. At Tana, you can make a tangible contribution to digital solutions used globally while supporting more efficient and sustainable waste management.

If you are ready to help shape the next generation of Tana’s digital services and turn connected-machine data into meaningful solutions, we would love to hear from you!

Location: Preferably Jyväskylä or Tampere, other locations negotiable.

For more information, please contact Petteri Tiainen, Engineering & Product Manager, Control Systems, tel. +358 40 762 7274, during the following times: Friday 18.9 10:00-11:00, Wednesday 23.9 09:00-10:00 or Thursday 1.10 13:00-14:00.

Please submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 4 October 2026
. Please note that interviews may be conducted during the application period as suitable candidates are identified.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Job ID: 6158

We are seeking two AI Engineers to develop, deploy, and maintain advanced Agent solutions using Microsoft Azure, Power Platform (Power Automate, Copilot Studio), and AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock). You will collaborate with developers and business partners to drive large-scale AI adoption.

About Our Team

Nordea is hiring a Generative AI Engineer (Full-Stack Developer) for our AI & Change Team in Personal Banking. Join us to drive innovation and use Generative AI to reshape banking. AI & Change works across the Nordics, and you will be working alongside other Generative AI engineers, Business Analysts and our Business Units. As we are a new unit, you will have a unique opportunity to shape our culture, leaving your mark on our future ways of working. Your contribution will be key in the implementation of a wide range of solutions that aim to improve our customer solutions and internal processes.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

What You’ll Be Doing

Main responsibilities in this role:

Develop, maintain and build AI agents through AI Solutions, both in Microsoft (Power Platform using Power Automate, Copilot Studio and related Azure AI services) and Amazon (AWS products, Bedrock and Sagemaker)
Develop, maintain and quality assure Python and Java applications (Data processing, API and MCP integrations)
Work closely with colleagues, including business users, risk managers, and product leads—serving as their technical collaborator and quality assurance partner
Apply AI responsibly, ensuring and driving how guardrails, test automation and monitoring meet compliance
Documentation and versioning of workflows in accordance with governance
Collaboration with DevOps teams on CI/CD via Jenkins and BitBucket

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you are a curious, innovative team player with a can-do attitude, always looking for ways on how we can unlock the next level for our customers.

Your background and skills include:

3+ years of professional experience from working as a Microsoft Power Platform developer (Automate and Copilot Studio)
Experience with Cloud vendors and their offerings (Azure and AWS)
Proven experience with Prompt Engineering, MLOps, vector databases and non-trivial Retrieval Augmented techniques
Production experience with classical ML and generative AI applications
Practical experience with Python and Java programming, including development of applications for automation, data processing, API and MCP integrations
Experience with Containerization (Docker), Orchestration (Kubernetes) and Infrastructure as Code/CLIs (Terraform, Microsoft Power Platform CLI)
Knowledge of CI/CD processes via Bitbucket, Jenkins
Experience with AI testing. Manual or automated
Ability to document and version workflows and scripts in accordance with governance requirements

It would be ideal if you also:

Have a knack for analysing Business processes and understands how to connect and optimise them with AI
Have a keen interest in data and how we design, develop and apply it with AI

This role is open for candidates who live in or in the surrounding area of Helsinki, Finland or Copenhagen, Denmark.

What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 09/10/2026.

For more information, you’re welcome to contact Iulia Ioanitescu at iulia.ioanitescu@nordea.com.

is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW

You will be an integral member of an algorithmic trading team comprising experienced technologists, quantitative researchers, and traders. Your team will work closely to solve challenging technological problems. We are looking for talented programmers eager to develop new technologies that directly impact our business.

Design, build, test, and maintain data-intensive desktop applications and reusable libraries using C# and modern .NET
Develop and maintain systems to ensure application performance, integrity and reliability for maintaining maximal up-time, and logging and traceability to aid in the support of mission-critical production systems
Profile and improve rendering, memory usage, concurrency, reactive data pipelines, and application startup performance
Collaborate with quantitative researchers, traders, and other developers
Own software through its full lifecycle, including design, implementation, automated testing, instrumentation, deployment, staged rollout, and production support
Leverage AI-assisted and agentic development tools to accelerate delivery, improve software quality, and evolve the team’s engineering practices.

Requirements

Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related discipline or relevant work experience.
5+ years of professional software development experience, with substantial experience building C#/.NET desktop applications
A thorough understanding of C# UI development and tooling
Should be comfortable in a fast-paced environment that continually embraces the latest technologies and techniques.
Effective communication skills, ability to read and write high and mid-level architecture documentation
Awareness of emerging technologies/standards

jobs.description:
Reports to:
Knowledge Intelligence Pod (KIP) Lead

Working Pattern :
Full Time

Location:
Singapore

This role is based in Singapore and we're not able to offer relocation support for candidates outside this location. Applicants must already be based in or eligible to work in this location.

About Multiplier

Multiplier Holdings is a VC-backed startup that acquires and scales professional services firms with AI and automation. We operate in regulated, high-stakes verticals like tax and corporate accounting, where complex workflows and talent shortages make automation especially valuable.

Unlike traditional software vendors, we combine technology and service delivery under one roof, building in-house AI and workflow components configured per firm to boost efficiency and improve the experience for clients and staff. Learn more at multiplierholdings.com.

About The Knowledge Intelligence Pod

The Knowledge Intelligence Pod (KIP) is a vertical product team that owns knowledge-heavy product experiences end-to-end.

KIP helps firms and internal pods find the right information, extract the right facts, verify the evidence behind those facts, and use that knowledge to answer client information requests, prepare accounting working papers, and review documents. The team owns both user-facing product experiences and the core services behind them: document intelligence, search and retrieval, evidence/provenance, answering systems, evaluation, and quality loops.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior/Staff Engineer
to help define and build the technical foundation for KIP.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role spanning product engineering, systems architecture, applied AI, and correctness and reliability. You will write production code, design durable abstractions, set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and stay close enough to users to know whether the system is actually making professionals faster and more confident.

Beyond building these systems, you’ll own how they perform, scale, and stay reliable once real professionals depend on them.

What You'll Own

KIP already runs extraction, retrieval, review, and answering systems in real tax workflows. As Staff Engineer, you'll own the core and scale what's working:

Artifact-First Knowledge Platform

Evolve the core data model across documents, emails, uploads, and new sources.
Harden the workflow we run today: ingest, extract, correct, approve, search.
Extend the APIs behind extracted data, provenance, corrections, and approvals.
Push abstractions so new firms onboard without bespoke work.

Document Retrieval, Structuring, and Quality Control

Own the extractors, document analytics, and review surfaces in production.
Deepen structured outputs with confidence signals, provenance, and correction paths.
Expand observability: traces, prompt/model versions, failure modes, regressions.

Full-Stack Product Ownership

Own the review, correction, and answering surfaces professionals use.
Partner with tax professionals and accountants to automate their real workflows.
Turn ambiguous problems into scoped bets and shipped systems.

Technical Leadership

Set technical direction as systems scale across firms and pods.
Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing, and hardening.
Raise the bar on testing, evals, observability, and security.
Partner with the Pod Lead to own the roadmap.

Who You Are

8+ years building software, including Staff-level technical leadership on complex systems.
Product-minded and close to users. You judge success by whether professionals work faster and trust the output, not just whether the system returned a response, and you'll sit with tax pros and accountants to watch real work firsthand.
Strong across the stack. You move comfortably between backend systems, APIs, data models, review UIs, and production debugging.
Ideally experienced with applied AI and/or financial systems and data. You've worked deeply with LLMs, retrieval, extraction, and agents, or with the data behind financial and accounting workflows.
Calm with ambiguity, high on ownership. You turn a fuzzy problem into a plan, a shipped system, and a measurable feedback loop, validating hypotheses and adapting as you learn, without waiting for perfect specs.
A strong technical communicator. You write crisp design docs, explain tradeoffs plainly, and align engineering, product, and domain experts around a path forward.

What This Role Is Not

A research-only AI role. You'll experiment with models, retrieval, and agents, but the job is shipping reliable systems into real workflows.
A prompt-engineering-only role. Prompting matters, but the hard work is systems design, evaluation, and earning user trust.
An internal platform or infrastructure-only role. KIP is a vertical product team measured by direct customer value, not internal tickets.
A pure people-management role. You'll lead technically and mentor engineers, but this is a hands-on Staff Engineer role.

Why Join Us

You'll help build the knowledge layer for AI-native professional services firms: the systems that turn messy documents, communications, and firm knowledge into structured, verifiable intelligence professionals can act on. KIP sits at the intersection of financial data and applied AI, where correctness is non-negotiable and the bar for accuracy is high.

The work is early enough that you can shape the architecture, engineering standards, and product direction, and real enough that you'll see whether staff trust what you build and whether it removes painful manual work. If you want to build applied AI systems that become dependable infrastructure for high-stakes professional work, this is it.

What We Offer

A high-impact Staff Engineer role shaping KIP's technical foundation, with direct access to real users and fast feedback loops.
Scope to influence architecture across extraction, retrieval, evaluation, and product surfaces.
Competitive salary plus performance-based bonus and equity.
Unlimited paid leave to rest and recharge.
Remote or flexible hybrid work depending on location.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.
